scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:up: docker-compose up -d && node -e "setTimeout(()=>{}, 5000)" && cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && cd .. && npm run dev
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "cd backend && npm run dev:watch" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run build -w @matchmind/shared-types && cd backend && npx prisma generate
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npm run typecheck && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: cd backend && npm run test:ci && cd ../frontend && npm run test

frontend/**/*.{ts,tsx}: bash -c 'if command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --ignore-unknown; fi';
backend/**/*.ts: bash -c 'if command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --ignore-unknown; fi';
*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}: bash -c 'if command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --ignore-unknown; fi';
*.{json,md,yml,yaml}: bash -c 'if command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --ignore-unknown; fi';
